Watcom field-by-field struct copy (3 consecutive `dst.field = src.field;` lines). Replace with `dst = src;` or `memcpy(&dst, &src, sizeof(...));` in a .keep — but only once the run (together with any sibling runs for the same dst/src pair) covers every byte of the struct. Collapsing a run that leaves a gap WIDENS the copy and changes behaviour; see `partial_struct_copy` (§31) for that case.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCStack_1c` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on an inner array field reached through a chained field path; the array decays to a pointer and `+ CONST` adds `CONST * sizeof(element)` bytes, matching the outer array stride. Replace `pCStack_1c->some_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.
